title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Health Insurance: SUL AMÉRICA – Family – no co-payment – Nationwide coverage (free monthly membership)
  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.
  • Private pension plan
  • Christmas gift card
  • Meal voucher
  • On-site meals
  • Pharmacy voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • Toys – children up to 12 years old
  • Bonuses based on goal achievement

Working Hours: Administrative Shift

Work Location: Av. Darcy Vargas, 325 - Santanésia - Piraí/ Rio de Janeiro

title: Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor
description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.
  • Background & Experience
  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Vem transformar com a gente!

Essa é uma iniciativa estratégica que une ciência de dados, inteligência artificial e visão de negócios, promovendo maior eficiência e competitividade no mercado global. Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Produção, Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Ciência de Dados

Doutorado em metodologias de computação, matemática aplicada, estatística, bioestatística, gestão de operações, ciência de dados, inteligência artificial, controle de processos industriais ou áreas afins com foco em modelagem matemática e aprendizado de máquina.

  • Caret

  • (ou similares)

  • Gestão e governança de dados (preparação, curadoria e uso de dados para treinamento e validação de modelos)

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)

Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.

Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)

Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.

Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of . We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle , Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • You’ll be working with many strategic leaders within the company.
  • The ETL Engineering team is growing rapidly.
  • You’ll be challenged with a lot of big data problems.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic ETL Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of software engineering experience and/or data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimize for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Additionally, ETL Engineering serves as the gold standard for all other YipitData analyst teams, building and maintaining the core pipelines that power our products. This high-impact, high-visibility team is instrumental to the success of our rapidly growing business. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced strategic team and help solve some of our biggest data challenges.

We expect US East Coast work hours:

  • Candidates should be available and willing to work during East Coast business hours (approximately 10/11am – 6/7pm EST).

As Our Data Engineer You Will:

  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using Pyspark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL toolings.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in other technical function.
  • You are excited about solving data challenges and learning new skills.
  • You have some understanding of working with data or building data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind data transformations to ensure alignment with organizational goals and data strategy.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working collaboratively with stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must

- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Test management

- Understanding of Trade life cycle

- Understanding of Market Data management

- Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

- Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.

- Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.

- Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.

- Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

Requirements

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation

Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch

System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic

Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health

Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams

Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

  • analytics requests

  • where necessary

  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests

Required Experience

  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale

  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices

Additional Information

title: Especialista em segurança do trabalho
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

DESAFIO

Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação.

Atividades principais

  • Elaborar, buscar aprovação, implementar e manter políticas e programas de segurança do trabalho, alinhados às legislações vigentes (NRs – Normas Regulamentadoras) e às necessidades da sua área de atuação promovendo a cultura de segurança no ambiente de trabalho, assegurando que todos os colaboradores conheçam e sigam as diretrizes de segurança;
  • Identificar riscos potenciais nas atividades da sua área de atuação;
  • Treinar e conscientizar os colaboradores sobre a importância do uso de EPIs e supervisionar sua utilização no ambiente de trabalho, assim como, garantir que os EPIs estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações e com a NR-6;
  • Planejar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos sobre segurança do trabalho, como NR-12 (Segurança em Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura), entre outros;
  • Treinar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros, capacitando os colaboradores para agir em casos de acidentes ou situações críticas.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nas áreas produtivas, verificando as condições de trabalho, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura para identificar e corrigir potenciais irregularidades;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas de segurança, bem como, acompanhar as auditorias de certificação como OHSAS 18001 ou ISO 45001, e implementar planos de ação para melhorias contínuas na segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes de trabalho, levantando dados, fatos e evidências, realizando as análises conforme metodologia pré-definida;
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de segurança;
  • Implementar e manter programas como o Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais (PPRA) e o Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) , em conformidade com a NR-9 e NR-7;
  • Implementar o Plano de Atendimento a Emergências (PAE) , assegurando que os colaboradores estejam preparados para lidar com emergências;
  • Coordenar a eleição, formação e atuação da CIPA , em conformidade com a NR-5, garantindo a capacitação dos participantes;
  • Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndios estejam instalados, funcionando adequadamente e em conformidade com a legislação vigente;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs (indicadores-chave de desempenho) de segurança, como taxa de frequência de acidentes , taxa de gravidade , acidentes com afastamento etc.;

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.g., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

title: Gerente de contas B2B
description:
A Indigo é uma empresa multinacional que tem por propósito transformar o agronegócio através do nosso portfólio de produtos biológicos, programas de crédito de carbono e soluções de crédito agrícola.

Queremos ser o parceiro número um dos nossos clientes , cuidando de suas produções agrícolas, garantindo sustentabilidade ao meio ambiente , além de contribuir para uma alimentação mundial cada vez mais saudável.

É questionando que evoluímos.

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Contas, que será responsável por desenvolver, gerenciar e expandir relacionamentos comerciais com indústrias estratégicas no setor agrícola. Atuando com foco em produtos biológicos, o profissional irá promover soluções sustentáveis, construir valor para os clientes e garantir a implementação bem-sucedida dos produtos no campo.

Considerando suas atividades, podemos destacar:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes B2B no setor agrícola, com foco em produtos biológicos (biofungicidas, bioinseticidas, bioestimulantes, entre outros).
  • Atuar como ponto de contato estratégico entre a empresa e os clientes, assegurando comunicação eficaz, alinhamento técnico e comercial.
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócios e desenvolver planos para ampliar a base de clientes e o market share.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente os clientes na introdução e uso correto dos produtos, em parceria com o time de P&D.
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e comerciais, treinamentos e dias de campo.
  • Negociar contratos, volumes e políticas comerciais de forma alinhada à estratégia da empresa.
  • Monitorar KPIs de vendas, forecast e performance de contas.
  • Alimentar o CRM com informações de mercado, concorrência e movimentações dos clientes.

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga?

  • Formação superior em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em posições de vendas ou gestão de contas B2B no setor agrícola.
  • Conhecimento técnico insumos biológicos, microbiologia agrícola, práticas sustentáveis ou agricultura regenerativa é altamente desejável.
  • Habilidades de negociação, relacionamento interpessoal e orientação a resultados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Excel, PowerPoint e sistemas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Proatividade e perfil empreendedor.
  • Comunicação clara e persuasiva.
  • Visão estratégica de mercado.
  • Capacidade de lidar com objeções e ambientes técnicos.
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.

Venha fazer parte desse time que está transformando a agricultura!

title: Estagiário de treinamento comercial
description:
Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo L’Occitane, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

L'OCCITANE é uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos L’Occitaners, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.

Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade.

Nosso escritório está localizado em São Paulo (Zona Sul)/SP e atuamos em formato 100% presencial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Suporte na construção e envio de convites de treinamentos
  • Apoio nos calendários e comunicados
  • Apoio & condução nas premiações de campanhas de treinamento
  • Alimentação de indicadores: Report e estudo analíticos dos dados de treinamento
  • Suporte na edição de vídeos e materiais de apoio ao time de vendas
  • Acompanhamento de despesas & orçamento
  • Suporte no controle de notas & fornecedores
  • Organização da academie & solicitação de produtos
  • Apoio no gerenciamento da base de usuários plataforma Bites

Requisitos e qualificações

Superior cursando nas áreas da Comunicação, MKT, Farmácia, administração.

  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar de segunda a sexta, com a carga horária de 6h diárias + 1 h de intervalo (9h as 16h ou 10h as 17h)

Informações adicionais

  • Aqui você conta com Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação flexível
  • Como trabalhamos em formato híbrido, você também terá direito ao Vale Transporte
  • Sua saúde e da sua família é PRIORIDADE, por isso temos assistência médica Sul América e assistência odontológica Odontoprev
  • Também temos o Programa Sou'L (programa de saúde psicológica e bem estar), onde você e seus dependentes poderão contar com Orientação Jurídica, Financeira e Psicológica
  • Sua saúde física também é importante, por isso também contamos com o Total Pass
  • E o cuidado vai além, contando com o Seguro de Vida
  • No mês do seu aniversário, você terá direito ao day off de aniversário, vale festa e v oucher de presente (para produtinhos de Loja ou quem sabe uma ida ao SPA)
  • Temos parceria com a plataforma Elleve com descontos exclusivos em diversas Instituições de Ensino de idioma, graduação e pós graduação para impulsionar o desenvolvimento
  • Também temos parceria com Duolingo, para aulas de idiomas
  • Ah, e pensou que não teria desconto? Contamos com desconto de até 40% em nossas lojas e até 50% em nossos SPAs
  • Incentivamos o bem e a sustentabilidade, então anualmente temos ações conectadas com Voluntariado em diversas ONGs
  • Durante o ano, contamos com ações junto ao nosso time de lojas, por exemplo o Viva Loja , onde nosso time administrativo vive um dia com nosso time de varejo
  • Sextou: Que tal sair cedo 1x por mês? #ShortFriday!

title: Gerente de controladoria
description:
Vaga: Gerente de Controladoria

Local: São Sebastião – SP

Empresa: Companhia Docas de São Sebastião (CDSS)

A Companhia Docas de São Sebastião (CDSS) , empresa pública responsável pela administração do Porto de São Sebastião, busca um Gerente de Controladoria para integrar sua estrutura de gestão. O profissional atuará de forma estratégica na condução dos processos contábeis, fiscais, orçamentários e patrimoniais, assegurando conformidade regulatória, transparência e suporte qualificado à alta administração.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Gestão dos processos fiscais e contábeis , garantindo conformidade com a legislação vigente.
  • Elaboração, acompanhamento e controle da gestão orçamentária .
  • Coordenação de auditorias contábeis internas e externas.
  • Gestão patrimonial , incluindo o controle e atualização do inventário de bens .
  • Prestação de contas à Administração Pública Estadual, ao Tribunal de Contas e à Pasta Tutelar .
  • Utilização e acompanhamento dos sistemas corporativos de gestão, com foco na confiabilidade das informações gerenciais.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis , Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em gestão orçamentária e fiscal .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em legislação fiscal e contábil .
  • Vivência em processos de controle, conformidade e reporte institucional.
Diferenciais
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com o Sistema Oracle .
  • Vivência em planejamento e gestão orçamentária pública .
  • Conhecimento em legislação pública e contabilidade regulatória aplicada a empresas públicas do setor portuário .
Perfil Desejado
  • Profissional dinâmico , hands-on , com iniciativa e visão crítica.
  • Forte orientação para melhoria contínua , com foco em transformação digital e uso de ferramentas informatizadas para otimização de processos.
  • Capacidade de atuação estratégica e interface com a alta administração.
Benefícios
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Vale-alimentação/refeição.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica.
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação profissional.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.

About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.

Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Sênior FIDS (Investigações) - São Paulo
description:

Aqui o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento são constantes. E o nosso espírito colaborativo faz toda a diferença para o seu crescimento individual e conquistas em equipe.

Nossos times são formados por pessoas autênticas, com trajetórias, habilidades e talentos únicos. Se você é uma pessoa movida a desafios e determinada a fazer a diferença.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

  • Realizar análise de documentos, fluxos, registros eletrônicos e bases de dados para identificação de indícios, padrões e riscos;
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos, apresentações e papéis de trabalho com clareza, objetividade e rigor técnico ;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de conceitos de investigação interna e boas práticas de compliance;
  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento e organização do trabalho;

  • Familiaridade com legislações anticorrupção e frameworks de integridade (Lei 12.846, FCPA, UK Bribery Act, Sapin II, ISO 37001/37301/37302/37308);

Formação Acadêmica

Conhecimentos

  • Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais a depender do escopo da investigação.

Habilidades e atitudes desejáveis

  • Visão analítica/crítica e capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Organização;
  • Comunicação assertiva;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Comprometimento;
  • Confidencialidade;
  • Integridade e Ética Profissional;
  • Liderança e Gestão de Equipe.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA
description:
Quer crescer junto com uma empresa que está transformando a educação com tecnologia e IA?

Se você gosta de desenvolver aplicações modernas, tem curiosidade por Inteligência Artificial, e quer trabalhar em um time que está criando agentes de IA e soluções inteligentes no Azure, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA para fortalecer nossa nova área de AI Solutions e ajudar a construir soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, automações e integrações inteligentes.

Como será a sua contribuição no time:

  • Desenvolver agentes de IA, aplicações e APIs com foco em IA Generativa (agentes conversacionais, análise de sentimentos, tradução, sumarização, automações).
  • Implementar lógica e fluxos de agentes de IA, ajustando prompts e comportamentos conforme diferentes cenários de uso.
  • Integrar modelos de IA (LLMs) às aplicações utilizando APIs, SDKs e bibliotecas especializadas.
  • Construir e manter microsserviços escaláveis, com atenção à performance e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar o monitoramento e a evolução das soluções de IA em produção, garantindo estabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com áreas de produto, engenharia e IA, participando ativamente das decisões técnicas.

Se você… já tem experiência como desenvolvedor(a) full stack, curiosidade por IA e vontade de aprender e crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador — essa oportunidade pode ser sua!

Requisitos mínimos:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend (React ou Vue, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend (Node.js e/ou Python).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Experiência ou forte interesse em integração com serviços de IA/LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).
  • Criação e otimização de prompts para agentes de IA.
  • Conhecimento em Git para versionamento de código (Azure DevOps ou GitHub).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e serviços como:
  • Azure SQL e Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime)

Diferenciais que contam pontos:

  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework ou similares.
  • Vivência com Azure Functions, arquitetura serverless ou integrações com APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Redis para cache ou filas.
  • Interesse ou experiência com Azure AI Foundry.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Vibe Coding), utilizando ferramentas como: GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, etc..
  • Ter atuado em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Um ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado contínuo.
  • Projetos reais com IA aplicada a problemas do dia a dia.
  • Stack moderna e liberdade para experimentar e evoluir.
  • Participação direta na construção de uma nova área estratégica da empresa.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento técnico e profissional.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos
description:

O Analista de Recursos Humanos atua como parceiro estratégico de negócio, suportando líderes intermediários e equipes em todos os temas relacionados a RH. Sua missão é garantir que as práticas de gestão de pessoas estejam alinhadas à estratégia da companhia, promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento, desempenho e bem-estar dos colaboradores.

title: ENGENHEIRO DE CUSTOS E SOLUÇÕES TÉCNICAS INSTALAÇÕES
description:
1. Apresentação da Oportunidade

Construtora com atuação em projetos industriais e farmacêuticos busca profissional para integrar a engenharia de custos e soluções técnicas, atuando de forma estratégica na análise, organização e consolidação de informações técnicas e financeiras de sistemas críticos, garantindo clareza, rastreabilidade e suporte à tomada de decisão.

2. Objetivo da Posição

Atuar no suporte técnico-financeiro do projeto, realizando análises de soluções de engenharia e validação do custo, com forte foco em organização de dados, elaboração de planilhas comparativas e consolidação de orçamentos executivos.

3. Principais Responsabilidades

· Analisar projetos técnicos das disciplinas elétrica, utilidades, HVAC e instalações.

· Avaliar impactos técnicos e financeiros decorrentes da evolução de soluções de engenharia.

· Atuar na validação, consolidação e atualização do custo.

· Estruturar planilhas comparativas organizadas, contendo escopos, quantitativos, premissas e alternativas técnicas.

· Produzir relatórios e memoriais técnico-financeiros claros, organizados e rastreáveis.

· Atuar em interface com engenharia, suprimentos e obra.

4. Escopo Técnico

· Sistemas elétricos de baixa e média tensão.

· Utilidades industriais: água purificada, vapor limpo, ar comprimido e gases.

· Sistemas HVAC para ambientes controlados e farmacêuticos.

· Salas limpas (ISO 5 a 8).

· Integração de sistemas conforme requisitos GMP.

5. Requisitos Obrigatórios

· Formação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Civil ou correlatas).

· Experiência comprovada em engenharia de custos, orçamento e atualização de estimativas.

· Conhecimento sólido em elétrica, utilidades, HVAC e instalações.

· Muita experiência na elaboração de planilhas comparativas estruturadas.

· Excel avançado (organização, fórmulas, controles e rastreabilidade).

· Experiência em obras industriais ou farmacêuticas.

6. Diferenciais

· Vivência em projetos farmacêuticos e ambientes GMP.

· Conhecimento de normas ASHRAE, ISO 14644 e requisitos regulatórios.

· Experiência com análise de CAPEX.

· Vivência com BIM / Revit.

7. Perfil Comportamental

· Perfil analítico, organizado e estruturado.

· Atenção a detalhes e consistência de dados.

· Boa comunicação técnica.

· Capacidade de estruturar informações complexas de forma clara.

· Postura profissional, ética e confidencial.

8. Importância Estratégica da Posição

Esta posição é estratégica para garantir consistência técnica e financeira nas decisões relacionadas a sistemas críticos do projeto, fortalecendo a governança de custos e a confiabilidade das informações utilizadas em processos decisórios.

title: Condutor de veículos pesados
description:
Vaga: Motorista de Caminhão

Local: Madeireira Paranaense — Belo Horizonte/MG

Resumo da posição

Buscamos um profissional comprometido, responsável e experiente para atuar como motorista de caminhão no transporte de cargas para Madeireira Paranaense. O candidato será responsável por garantir entrega segura, dentro de prazos, cuidando da carga e representando a empresa com profissionalismo. Essa função é essencial para assegurar eficiência logística, qualidade no atendimento e cumprimento das demandas operacionais da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar o transporte de cargas conforme rota estabelecida pela empresa, garantindo pontualidade e integridade da carga.
  • Manusear o caminhão com segurança e responsabilidade, obedecendo às normas de trânsito e às regulamentações vigentes.
  • Realizar check-list e manutenção básica preventiva no veículo: verificar pneus, freios, fluidos, luzes e demais itens essenciais antes de cada saída.
  • Planejar rotas, conhecer as melhores estradas/itinerários e utilizar sistemas de navegação ou mapas, sempre que necessário.
  • Manter comunicação clara e frequente com a central de operações ou com o responsável logístico da empresa — informar horários, imprevistos e status das entregas.
  • Zelar pela segurança da carga, do veículo e de terceiros durante o transporte.
  • Preencher relatórios de viagem, controle de quilometragem, recibos de despesas (combustível, pedágios, etc.), documentação de carga, bem como demais registros exigidos pela empresa.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Habilitação e documentação

  • CNH compatível para condução de caminhão de carga — categoria conforme porte exigido pelo veículo/carga (C, D ou E, conforme legislação e tipo de caminhão).
  • Documentação pessoal e de habilitação regularizadas e atualizadas (CNH, documentos de identificação).

Experiência e formação

  • Experiência prévia como motorista de caminhão — idealmente com transporte de cargas, de preferência cargas volumosas ou pesadas, como madeira, materiais de construção, ou similares.
  • Desejável conhecimento básico de mecânica e manutenção preventiva de caminhões (verificação de pneus, freios, fluidos, iluminação, etc.).
  • Desejável, embora não obrigatório: curso de formação para motoristas profissionais — direção defensiva, transporte de cargas, normas de segurança etc .

Competências comportamentais

  • Direção defensiva e consciente: atenção redobrada ao trânsito, respeito às leis, prudência e foco na segurança.
  • Capacidade de planejamento e organização: roteirização, controle de documentação e registro de viagens, organização da carga e do veículo.
  • Comunicação clara e profissional, tanto com a empresa quanto com clientes ou responsáveis pela carga, sempre que necessário.
  • Comportamento resiliente e responsável — ser capaz de lidar com viagens longas, imprevistos no trânsito, eventuais contratempos com calma e responsabilidade.
  • Compromisso com pontualidade, cumprimento de prazos e zelo pela carga e pelo veículo.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e colaboração com a logística da empresa, quando necessário (ex: carregamento/descarregamento, comunicação com equipe de apoio, manutenção).

Diferenciais desejáveis (pontos que valorizam o candidato)

  • Experiência anterior no transporte de madeira ou materiais de construção.
  • Curso de aperfeiçoamento no transporte de cargas — segurança, direção defensiva, responsabilidade ambiental, entre outros.
  • Histórico de direção limpa, sem grandes infrações ou acidentes.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e horários flexíveis, se necessário.

Contratação:

  • Modelo: CLT
  • Remuneração: R$2.870,15
  • Benefícios: R$25,00 VR dia + Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível
  • Carga horária: Seg a Sexta: 08:00 às 17:30 (1:30 almoço) / Sab: 08:00 às 12:00

title: Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)
description:
Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)

Greater Sao Paulo Area / Hybrid

Greater Rio de Janeiro Area / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

• Intelligence

• Integrity

• Initiative

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) II will be the primary liaison between the Investigator sites and Nexcella, responsible for overall site conduct and establishing important relationships with key site personnel. The CRA will perform key job functions in accordance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH GCP), FDA regulations, Nexcella SOPs and work practices while supporting the organizational mission to advance the development of promising oncology therapies and technologies to benefit patients. CRAs are expected to work in a hands-on, highly visible and autonomous role. CRAs must have the ability to be flexible and represent Nexcella in a positive and professional manner while collaborating across all levels with the clinical teams and Sponsors/vendors.

Responsibilities :

• Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits of investigational sites for the Nexcella portfolio of clinical trials.

• Manage the progress of assigned sites by tracking patient recruitment and enrollment, CRF completion and submission, source data verification, data collection, and data query generation and resolution.

• Conduct monitoring activities, including, but not limited to the following:

o Ensuring PI oversight of all trial activities

o Source data review and verification with EDC fields

o Essential documentation review and reconciliation

o Investigational Product (IP) management and accountability

o Lab/kit supply management

• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites and personnel.

• Maintain communication with sites through frequent contact to ensure site compliance, adequate enrollment, and understanding of study requirements.

• Write and submit complete and accurate visit letters and reports of investigational site findings and update applicable CTMS.

• Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.

• Participate in audit preparations and follow-up, as needed.

• Review and address protocol deviations, data quality issues, and identify process improvements for assigned sites.

• Be a collaborative member of the study team: provide insight, updates, and strategies to improve processes.

• Ability to think critically while prioritizing tasks in an efficient manner to meet study deliverables.

• Contribute to CRF development and perform User Access Testing, as requested.

• Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in life science/biomedical/medical science with a proficient knowledge of the clinical/scientific terminology and methods common to the oncology therapeutic setting.

• 2+ years clinical research experience is required.

• 2+ years experience at a CRO or Sponsor required.

• Independent field monitoring experience of oncology clinical trials is required.

• Early phase oncology experience is preferred.

• Proficient knowledge and practical utilization of ICH- GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrate effective presentation skills by clearly explaining complex concepts to a broad range of audiences.

• Ability to independently prioritize tasks with excellent time management skills.

• Highly proficient in computer applications including Microsoft suite of applications, EDC and CTMS applications.

• Fluent in English (written and verbal)

About Nexcella

Nexcella Inc., a wholly-owned Immix Biopharma subsidiary, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company trailblazing cell therapies in AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora Comercial
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;
  • Gestão jurídica contratual e ações relacionadas ao empreendimento;
  • Contribuir com a elaboração e principalmente execução do planejamento estratégico e orçamento plurianual do Shopping por meio de participação em comitês comerciais semanais e demais rotinas junto ao time de Analistas, Assistentes, Estagiário e Auxiliares;
  • Garantir a veracidade das informações e todos os KPIS da área comercial, que auxiliarão na tomada de decisão do Shopping através da consolidação e análise de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Maximizar os recursos disponíveis com o objetivo de rentabilizar todas as linhas de receita do empreendimento, principalmente as linhas ligadas aos resultados, assim como na otimização dos custos;
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas do time.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Economia, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou correlatas;

title: Business Analyst - Segment Management
description:
Role Summary

The Business Analyst – Segment Management is responsible for designing, analyzing, and continuously optimizing customer segments across the lending lifecycle . This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, advanced analytics, and execution , acting as a strategic partner to Product, Risk, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams.

The role requires a hybrid BI + BA profile : deep hands-on data analytics capability combined with strong business logic, financial acumen, and structured problem-solving skills. The individual will translate complex data into actionable segment strategies that drive portfolio growth, profitability, risk balance, and customer experience .

Key Responsibilities

1. Segment Strategy & Design

  • Design and maintain customer segmentation frameworks across the end-to-end lending lifecycle, including:
  • Acquisition segments (new-to-credit, new-to-platform, repeat borrowers)
  • Risk segments (score bands, behavior-based cohorts, early-warning segments)
  • Value segments (LTV-based, profitability-based, pricing sensitivity)
  • Behavioral segments (repayment behavior, utilization patterns, engagement)
  • Define clear segment objectives , eligibility rules, and success metrics aligned with business strategy.
  • Continuously refine segment definitions based on performance data and evolving portfolio dynamics.

2. Advanced Analytics & BI Ownership

  • Perform deep-dive analyses on segment-level performance , including:
  • Approval rate, conversion rate, booking volume
  • Utilization, repayment behavior, delinquency, roll-rates
  • Loss rate, margin, contribution profit, LTV
  • Own and enhance segment-level dashboards and reporting (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Grafana).
  • Build self-serve analytical datasets and metric definitions to ensure consistency across teams.
  • Ensure data accuracy, reconciliation, and alignment with Finance, Risk, and Data teams.

3. Business Problem Solving & Diagnosis

  • Act as a first-line analytical problem solver for segment-related business issues, such as:
  • Sudden drop in approval or conversion within a segment
  • Unexpected deterioration in repayment or delinquency
  • Misalignment between growth and risk performance
  • Conduct root-cause analysis using structured frameworks and data triangulation.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
  • Product teams to design segment-specific journeys, pricing, and offers
  • Risk teams on score thresholds, policy tuning, and early-warning indicators
  • Marketing / Growth teams on targeting, campaign optimization, and personalization
  • Operations & Customer Support on segment-specific issues, complaints, and exceptions
  • Finance on profitability, reconciliation, and forecasting
  • Serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and data/engineering teams , ensuring analytical requirements are correctly translated into data solutions.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support segment-level experimentation (A/B testing, policy experiments, offer testing).
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, and measurement frameworks.
  • Analyze experiment outcomes and provide data-driven recommendations for rollout or iteration.

6. Executive & Management Reporting

  • Prepare clear, concise, and insight-driven presentations for senior management.
  • Convert complex data into structured narratives highlighting risks, opportunities, and trade-offs.
  • Support strategic discussions around portfolio mix, growth targets, and risk appetite at a segment level.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Master’s degree (MBA, Analytics, Finance) is a strong plus.

Experience

  • 5–8+ years of experience in:
  • Business analytics, BI, segment management, or strategy roles
  • Lending, credit, banking, or fintech environments
  • Proven experience working in large financial institutions or scaled fintech platforms .
  • Direct exposure to retail lending products (personal loans, BNPL, credit cards, installment loans).

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong hands-on capability in:
  • SQL (advanced querying, joins, window functions)
  • BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
  • Excel / Google Sheets (advanced modeling, scenario analysis)
  • Solid understanding of:
  • Credit metrics and portfolio KPIs
  • Segment-level profitability and unit economics
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple systems.
